whoWeAre.title: Who we are
desc: We bring over 15 years of international experience (United Kingdom) in smart home systems, high-end AV installations, and advanced building automation.

We design and deliver exclusive solutions that seamlessly integrate technology into a perfectly unified system—with a focus on comfort, design, and absolute reliability. We work with premium platforms such as Crestron, Crestron Home, Loxone, and Lutron, enabling intuitive control of lighting, audio, video, shading, and the entire property environment.

We integrate all technologies—from multimedia and lighting to energy management—into a single elegant and easy-to-use platform. The result is a space that responds to user needs and delivers a truly exceptional experience.

Our projects also include advanced property security solutions. We implement professional systems from brands such as Jablotron, Paradox, and Risco, access control solutions like Salto, and modern surveillance and networking technologies from Ubiquiti.
Every project is unique to us—we create tailored solutions that meet the highest standards of security, aesthetics, and technological excellence.

showroom.title: Smart Home Showroom
description: P&A Vision is currently developing a dedicated smart home showroom where you'll be able to experience Crestron, Loxone, and Lutron systems first-hand. Our aim is to demonstrate, in one place, how lighting, shading, heating, and audio work together as a single connected ecosystem.

We're exploring several directions – a branded showroom in partnership with manufacturers such as Samsung, a professional audio recording studio, and a multi-purpose shared space combining smart home and commercial integration. We're choosing the concept that delivers the most value to our clients across the EU.

Until the showroom opens, our specialists will design a solution tailored precisely to your home or project. During a no-obligation consultation, we'll walk you through system integration, budget, and installation – clearly and without pressure.
Want to be among the first to see it? Get in touch and we'll keep you informed about the showroom launch and the latest in intelligent living for homes across Europe.

office.title: Smart Office & Workspace
description: Turn your office into a productive, professional environment. P&A Vision integrates meeting room booking, video conferencing, lighting, shading, climate control, and audio/video into a single system that adapts to your team's daily rhythm.

Your team books a meeting room with one tap, and the space prepares itself – the video call launches, the projection drops down, and lighting and blinds adjust automatically. A panel by the door shows at a glance whether the room is free or busy, so meetings never overlap.

Run seamless video conferences with automatic audio and camera control, without fiddling with the tech. Smart management also cuts running costs through automatic lighting and efficient temperature regulation – all monitored and controlled from one place.
We design and deliver meeting room booking and video conferencing solutions for offices and corporate spaces across the EU. Reliably, elegantly, and with attention to detail.

familyHome.title: Smart Family Home
description: Create a home that takes care of the whole family. P&A Vision connects lighting, heating, shading, security, and entertainment into one intuitive system powered by Crestron, Loxone, and Lutron.
Morning and evening scenes, automated blinds, and zoned temperature control keep every room comfortable. The home anticipates your needs and saves energy without any manual adjustment.
Peace of mind comes first – control camera systems, smart locks, and access management from your phone, anywhere. Stay in touch with what's happening at home, even remotely.
We deliver smart family homes across Europe, with a solution tailored to your lifestyle and budget.

business.title: Smart Solutions for Business & Commercial Spaces
description: From hotels and restaurants to retail and showrooms – P&A Vision delivers professional automation and network infrastructure for commercial spaces. Structured cabling, Wi-Fi networks, CCTV and security systems, and access control work together as one reliable whole.

A dependable network is the foundation of every operation. We design and build network infrastructure with security at its core – network segmentation, firewall, monitoring, and backup – and connect it with cameras, access systems, and alarms in a single clear interface.

Cut electricity consumption through smart energy management – automatic shutdown of devices, plus lighting and climate control based on occupancy and schedule. You get real-time visibility into costs, and the system scales as your business grows.
We design and integrate networks, security, and energy-saving solutions for businesses across the EU – with a focus on reliability, safety, and a professional appearance.
